M2fKMP47slQ.text: It has the right asymptotic guarantees for a hash map, but beyond that it doesn't have much going for it. The degree to which it emphasizes pointer/iterator stability and arbitrary load factors is not a good tradeoff in almost any practical case (unless you do not care about performance). See [VIDEO] for a more comprehensive discussion, or the sibling threads here.
